zh-CN.title: CAD 设计
zh-CN.description: 在独立的“设计”页面上与助手一起设计零件：助手在对话专属的 CAD 容器中编写多体 OpenSCAD 模型，逐个渲染零件体，检查干涉、截面、打印和强度，并导出 STEP。每次渲染都会成为一个新版本，页面在对话旁显示该版本的三维零件体、视图、检查结果和文件。

usage.title: 新建设计并描述零件
usage.description: 打开侧栏中的“设计”，新建一个设计，在左侧对话框中说明零件的用途、以毫米为单位的尺寸和需要活动的部分。助手会先提出方案，然后编写模型并渲染。

usage.title: 查看最新版本
usage.description: 每次渲染完成后，右侧预览会显示最新版本：每个零件体使用不同颜色，可以单独显示或隐藏。“视图”页签显示着色渲染图和截面图，“检查”页签汇总干涉、间隙和打印检查结果，“代码”页签以只读方式显示该版本的 OpenSCAD 源码，“文件”页签提供下载链接。

usage.title: 回看旧版本并继续修改
usage.description: 可以切换到任一旧版本查看；在查看旧版本时发送的消息会告诉助手你正在看哪个版本。删除的设计会进入回收站，可以恢复或彻底删除；彻底删除也会删除设计对话及其所有版本文件。

usage.title: 导出文件
usage.description: 满意后请助手导出：它会写出每个零件体的 STEP 文件和 3MF 文件，并在“文件”页签中提供打印布局的 STL、切片结果和源码。

requirements: 需要按对话分配的容器沙箱和 CAD 镜像：先运行 make sandbox-cad-image，再运行 make sandbox-enable MODE=container IMAGE=cad，然后重启 Gateway。未启用时页面会显示这些设置命令。
模型编写的代码只在该对话的容器中运行，Gateway 从不执行它；导出较大的 STEP 文件时，可以在 Gateway 的环境中设置 DEER_FLOW_SANDBOX_MEMORY=4g，提高容器默认 2 GiB 的内存上限。
通过登录后的浏览器会话使用；三维预览需要支持 WebGL 的浏览器；设计对话不会出现在聊天列表中。

en-US.title: CAD designs
en-US.description: Design a part with the assistant on its own Designs page. The assistant writes multi-body OpenSCAD in the conversation's CAD container, renders each body, checks clashes, sections, print and strength, and exports STEP. Every render is a new version, and the page shows that version's bodies in 3D, its views, its checks and its files beside the conversation.

usage.title: Start a design and describe the part
usage.description: Open Designs in the sidebar, create a design, and describe in the conversation on the left what the part does, its sizes in millimetres and what has to move. The assistant proposes a mechanism, then writes the model and renders it.

usage.title: Look at the newest version
usage.description: After each render the preview on the right shows the newest version: one colour per body, and each body can be shown or hidden. Views shows the shaded render and the sections, Checks summarises the clash, gap and print checks, Code shows that version's OpenSCAD read-only, and Files links every file.

usage.title: Go back to an older version
usage.description: Pick any older version to look at it; a message you send while looking at one tells the assistant which version you mean. Deleted designs go to the trash, where you can restore or purge them; purging also deletes the design's conversation and all its version files.

usage.title: Export the files
usage.description: When you are happy, ask the assistant to export: it writes a STEP file per body and a 3MF, and Files links them with the print-layout STLs, the sliced G-code and the source.

requirements: It needs the per-thread container sandbox with the CAD image: run make sandbox-cad-image, then make sandbox-enable MODE=container IMAGE=cad, then restart the Gateway. Until then the page shows those commands.

Model-written code runs only in the conversation's container, never in the Gateway. For large STEP exports, DEER_FLOW_SANDBOX_MEMORY=4g in the Gateway's environment raises the container's 2 GiB memory cap.
It works from a signed-in browser session; the 3D preview needs a browser with WebGL, and design conversations stay out of the chat list.
